sections.title: Slack
sections.content: Join our Slack to chat with the community.

sections.title: Channels
sections.content: Channels group conversations by topic, location, and interest. Browse the channel list in Slack to find yours.

sections.title: Guidelines
sections.content: Be kind, stay on topic, and follow the code of conduct. Moderators may remove messages from Slack that break these rules.

sections.title: Moderation
sections.content: Report problems to the moderators, who review every report and reply privately through Slack direct messages.
